title: The Chain of Origins: Every Good Traced to Its Divine Source
description: A hymnic litany that names, in descending order of emanation, the specific divine source from which each class of good and each operation of redemption proceeds — beginning at the Father of Lights and ending at the Mind of Light who awakens sleepers and raises them eight-fold. Gifts, blessings, counsels, honors, warriors, builders, releasers, wisdoms, awakenings: each class traced back to its proper origin.
